rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for a distinction or a feature that makes two things different.

example.english: The biggest difference between these two versions is the price.
example.traditional: 呢兩個版本最大嘅分別係價錢。
example.jyutping: ni1 loeng5 go3 baan2 bun2 zeoi3 daai6 ge3 fan1 bit6 hai6 gaa3 cin2

rows.note: Use this when “difference” means an effect or impact on a situation or person.

example.english: This heavy rain makes a big difference to traffic.
example.traditional: 呢場大雨對交通嘅影響好大。
example.jyutping: ni1 coeng4 daai6 jyu5 deoi3 gaau1 tung1 ge3 jing2 hoeng2 hou2 daai6

rows.note: Use this mathematical term for the result of subtracting one number from another.

example.english: The difference between nine and five is four.
example.jyutping: gau2 gaam2 ng5 caa1 hai6 sei3

rows.note: Use this colloquial noun for a disagreement or argument between people.

example.english: My brother and I had a difference of opinion over the room.
example.traditional: 我同阿哥為咗間房拗咗幾句。
example.jyutping: ngo5 tung4 aa3 go1 wai4 zo2 gaan1 fong2 ngaau2 zo2 gei2 geoi3
